title: WPSB/34/2023 of R P PANT Vs UNIVERSITY GRANTS COMMISSION THROUGH ITS SECRETARY

COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPSB No. 34 of 2023
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Per-Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate for the

Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, Standing Counsel for
the State.
Ms. Mamta Bisht, Advocate for Kumaon
University.
Ms. Anjali Bhargava, Advocate for UGC.
2. Petitioner was appointed as Lecturer in
Kumaon University on 13.09.1976. He was
promoted as Reader under Career Advancement
Scheme w.e.f. 22.06.1991, thereafter he was
promoted as Professor on 27.07.1998. Petitioner
retired from service after completing age of
superannuation i.e. 65 years on 30.06.2020.
3. According to the petitioner, he was entitled
to Higher Academic Grade, which is available to
senior professor, as per UGC Regulations w.e.f.
2009. Since that benefit was not given to
petitioner, therefore he has filed this writ petition
seeking following reliefs:
"I. issue a writ in the nature of Mandamus
commanding the Respondent No 1, 2 & 3 to grant the
antedated Personal Promotion to the Petitioner to the
Higher Academic Grade / Senior Professor in
compliance of the 2010 & 2018 Regulations from
31/12/2008.
II. issue a writ in the nature of Mandamus

commanding the Respondent No 1, 2 & 3 to grant the
arrears of pay to the Petitioner.
III. award costs to this Petition, as the
Respondent University has perpetuated statutory non-compliance for no reason what so ever, and has forced
the Petitioner to pursue the instant Petition for
enforcement of his rights."
4. Professor Atul Kumar Joshi, has filed
counter affidavit as Registrar, Kumaon University,
Nainital. Para 5 and 6 of said counter affidavit are
extracted below:
"5. That in reply to the para no. I of the writ
petition, it is stated that, the petitioner is claiming the
antedated personal promotion to the Higher Academic
Grade/senior professor. In this regard Kumaoun
University Nainital had already sent a letter no. 2252
dated 26.03.2015 to the Secretary Higher Education,
Government of Uttarakhand for sanction of above
mention pay-scale/AGP, so that, benefit of Career
Advancement Scheme, 2010 could be granted to eligible
Professor of the Kumaoun University Nainital as per
procedure described in the Scheme of University Grants
Commission. A letter dated 26.03.2005 is annexed
herewith marked as Annexure No. CA-1 to this affidavit.
6. That it is further submitted that some few other
letters i.e. letter no. 4270 dated 14.09.2018, letter no. 244
dated 06.05.2019 & letter no. 1852 dated 16.12.2019 also
send to the Government of Uttarakhand as reminder, but
till date sanction of Higher Grade of Professorship (Stage
6) in the pay scale Rs. 67000-79000 AGP 12,000/- has
not provided by the State Government.
Hence, petitioner's claim was not processed by the
Kumaoun University Nainital, and the petitioner has
superannuated from the services of the Kumaoun
University Nainital on dated 30.06.2020. Copies of letters
dated 14.09.2018, 06.05.2019 & 16.12.2019 are annexed
collectively marked as Annexure No. CA-2 to this
affidavit."
5. Learned State Counsel refers to counter
affidavit, filed by Mr. S.S. Tripathi, Deputy

Secretary, Higher Education on behalf of
respondent No. 2. Para 9 of the said counter
affidavit is reproduced below:
"9. That in reply to the contents of para no. 10 of
the writ petition, it is submitted that, since university has
not incorporated the said provisions in its statute as
required by GO dated 28 May, 2013, the application thus
invited bears no legal ground, because at that time the
said stage 6 of Professorship exists nowhere in the
University Statutes. Rest of the averments made in para
need no comments."
6. Ms. Mamta Bisht, learned counsel appearing
for Kumaon University, however, submits that the
stand taken in para 9 of the counter affidavit, filed
on behalf of the State is not correct, and submits
that State of Uttarakhand has adopted Career
Advancement Scheme vide Government Order
dated 28.05.2013, and thereafter Hon'ble Vice
Chancellor has sanctioned incorporation of Career
Advancement Scheme, 2010 in the Statute of
Kumaon University, Nainital, vide order dated
21.04.2022.
7. The only defence taken by State Government
was that Career Advancement Scheme introduced
by University Grants Commission (UGC) was not
incorporated in the First Statute of the University.
8. Learned counsel for the petitioner by
referring to Annexure-3 to the counter affidavit
filed on behalf of the University, submits that
relevant provisions of Career Advancement

Scheme has now become part of first statute of
Kumaon University, vide order dated 21.04.2022,
thus, now there is no legal impediment in
considering claim of the petitioner for Higher
Academic Grade.
9. The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of
by directing Vice Chancellor, Kumaon University
to consider the claim of petitioner and other
eligible persons, by constituting a Selection
Committee as per the applicable UGC Regulations
for grant of Higher Academic Grade. Such
committee shall be constituted within three weeks
from today.
10. If petitioner is found eligible for grant of
Higher Academic Grade, then necessary order
granting such benefit, shall be passed by
competent authority in the University, within four
months from today.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 29.04.2026
Mahinder/
